title: Fix the Age Check
description: The program should check whether age equals 18 and print a message. Fix the bug.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 'You are eighteen' when age is 18.
actualProblem: A single = is the assignment operator in Python, not comparison; using it inside an if condition is a SyntaxError.
explanation: Python deliberately disallows assignment inside a condition to prevent this exact mistake. Comparisons must use ==, the double-equals equality operator.
